baseline_models.focus_anchor: The ayah coordinates faith and sound intentional deeds with caused entry into gardens and flowing rivers, then coordinates denial with enjoyment, repeated eating, livestock comparison, and fire as a settled abode.
baseline_models.mechanism: The two halves form opposed life-processes. Purposeful outward action leads into a sheltered ecology whose provision keeps moving; pleasure reduced to intake leads through animalized consumption into a fixed destructive habitat.

activation_trace.role: Literal passage into an interior supplies the transition from conduct to inhabited consequence.
Heart-settling assent supplies the first cohort's inward orientation.
Deliberate action supplies purposive output rather than mere appetite.
Soundness opposed to corruption qualifies what the purposeful action produces.
A tree-sheltered garden supplies a living interior rather than an abstract prize.
Continuous physical running makes provision dynamic within that habitat.
Water cutting a channel through land gives the flow a sustaining material system.
Immediate pleasurable use supplies the second cohort's short-horizon benefit.
The doubled act of taking food inward makes consumption the cohort's defining process.
Grazing livestock supplies the explicit comparison that strips intake of reflective purpose.
Burning fire supplies the destructive environment reached by the intake-only process.
Settled residence converts fire from a passing event into the process's terminal habitat.

changed_reading.before: A direct reward-and-punishment contrast between believers and unbelievers.
changed_reading.after: A contrast between two whole regimes: purposive action entering sustained circulation, and appetite-only intake terminating in destructive settlement.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The garden and denial roots both activate covering, but one makes a protective living enclosure while the other hides truth; the latter terminates in visible burning.
baseline_models.mechanism: Covering is morally differentiated by what it does. Vegetative cover shelters and sustains life, while epistemic cover blocks truth; the second kind does not preserve its bearer but delivers the bearer into an exposed, burning abode.

activation_trace.role: Protective concealment supplies the garden side's enclosing operation.
Dense tree cover turns concealment into a habitable and fertile space.
Obscuring truth supplies the opposed, epistemic use of covering.
The bright, moving burn reverses concealment into an inescapably manifest endpoint.
The dwelling branch fixes that exposed endpoint as home rather than momentary contact.

changed_reading.before: Garden and denial are unrelated lexical items in a moral binary.
changed_reading.after: They stage rival coverings: one shelters life, while the other hides truth and paradoxically ends in permanent exposure to fire.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The first cohort is described by intentional work made sound; the second by pleasure and the twice-stated act of eating under a livestock simile.
baseline_models.mechanism: The decisive human contrast is not activity versus inactivity, since both cohorts act, but action governed by an intended fitting end versus behavior governed by immediate appetite. The animal comparison diagnoses a collapse of agency into consumption.

activation_trace.role: Intended action supplies the first cohort's purposive agency.
Fitness to an end makes those actions appropriate rather than merely numerous.
Enjoyable utility supplies an immediate end that can absorb attention.
Repeated feeding reduces the second cohort's displayed agency to bodily intake.
The livestock class makes unreflective appetite the explicit behavioral analogy.

changed_reading.before: The livestock comparison is a general insult about unbelief.
changed_reading.after: It precisely contrasts teleological agency with appetite: sound work is fitted to an end, while enjoyment contracts action into intake.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The garden half is verbal and kinetic: God brings people in and rivers keep running. The fire half closes with a nominal place of staying after an interval of enjoyment.
baseline_models.mechanism: A temporal-spatial asymmetry overlays the moral contrast. One destination remains internally mobile and continuously provisioned; the other group's extended enjoyment is bounded by conversion into a fixed residence.

activation_trace.role: Entry supplies directed movement across a boundary.
Running water supplies continuing internal motion.
Continuing provision turns motion into duration rather than spectacle.
An extended grant of enjoyment supplies a finite-looking interval before settlement.
Long residence supplies the still endpoint opposed to running flow.

changed_reading.before: Both halves simply name static destinations after death.
changed_reading.after: The syntax contrasts sustained movement within one habitat with temporary enjoyment hardening into terminal residence in the other.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence subjects deeds and defects to opposite transformations: deeds can lose their way, faults can be covered, and a person's condition can be repaired. The focus opposition therefore turns on the direction and object of covering, not on a simple possession or absence of works.

activation_trace.role: Loss supplies the operation by which apparently existing deeds fail to reach an outcome.
The same intended-action category as the focus becomes the object of directional loss.
Covering an offense supplies a beneficial use of the root that labels the focus's opposed cohort.
The paired deed-quality and causative repair make soundness both conduct and transformation.
A repaired state of well-being supplies an interior counterpart to later entry into a sound habitat.
At focus, the same root names concealment of truth, establishing the polarity reversal.

structural_cues: 47:1-2 place works under loss or repair before 47:12 sorts the two cohorts.
The same root used for denial in 47:12 is used transitively for removal of faults in 47:2.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lost deeds, covered faults, repaired condition, and the focus cohorts; I infer that these operations govern which habitat the focus discloses. A live alternative is a simpler ledger of reward and cancellation without an interior-to-habitat process.

changed_reading.before: Believers have good deeds and deniers lack them, so destinations follow a static ledger.
changed_reading.after: Deeds, faults, and inner condition are actively redirected, covered, or repaired; the decisive question is what is concealed and whether action is made sound enough to arrive.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier repetition of entry into the garden adds recognition by trace or mark. The focus's caused entry is therefore plausibly an arrival into a destination rendered identifiable, not displacement into an alien reward-space.

activation_trace.role: The repeated boundary-crossing ties the earlier destination directly to the focus entry.
The repeated sheltered garden fixes the same habitat as the object of recognition.
Knowing by a distinguishing sign supplies orientation and familiarity within the destination.
The focus repeats the caused entry whose experiential quality the earlier clause changes.

structural_cues: 47:6 presents the same entry-plus-garden pair six ayat before its fuller restatement in 47:12.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated entry, the same garden, and an act of recognition; I infer destination-familiarity as part of entry. The materially live alternative is that recognition means assigned locations or disclosure without prior familiarity.

changed_reading.before: Entry is transport into a promised but otherwise unknown place.
changed_reading.after: Entry is also orientation: the garden is made recognizable, so arrival carries intelligibility and belonging as well as location.

context_deltas.mechanism: Immediately before the focus, believers have governing care and support while deniers lack it. Read with caused entry and the dwelling-and-guest branch of the final abode, the destinations become an inverted hospitality relation: one cohort is conducted under patronage; the other is left with fire as host and home.

activation_trace.role: Taking charge of an affair supplies the governing care present for one cohort and denied to the other.
Protective alliance supplies the social relation behind the focus's causative entry.
Being brought inside becomes an act performed under that patronage.
The branch spanning dwelling, host, and guest lets the fire-abode form a grim substitute for absent patronage.

structural_cues: 47:11's patron/no-patron antithesis directly precedes 47:12's garden/fire antithesis.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies patronage, its negation, caused entry, and a lodging branch with hospitality roles; I supply the arrow from patronage to being conducted or hosted. The alternative is that patronage denotes only military or legal support, with no hospitality coloring.

changed_reading.after: The contrast is relational: protected people are conducted into a living interior, while people without a patron acquire fire itself as their only host and home.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later context shows bad action made attractive, desire followed, hearts sealed, and hearts locked. These cues turn the cattle-eating image into an epistemic feedback loop: appetite selects the attractive object, action follows it, and the organ of reconsideration closes.

activation_trace.role: Displayed attractiveness supplies the perceptual lure that makes harmful action look fit for consumption.
Inclination of the self supplies appetite as the selector of action.
A sealing imprint supplies closure against assimilation of what was heard.
The repeated self-inclination makes the closed loop persistent rather than incidental.
Hard closure supplies the endpoint at which deliberation can no longer reopen appetite's judgment.
Intended work remains the focus-side alternative to appetite-governed behavior.
Repeated intake supplies the bodily model for the closed epistemic loop.
Livestock behavior makes appetite without reflective revision the explicit comparison.

structural_cues: 47:14 and 47:16 repeat following desire around a scene of hearing without retention.
47:24 later recasts the failure as locked hearts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies attraction, desire-following, sealing, locking, and cattle-like eating; I infer a causal loop from appetite to selective perception to closure. The alternative is that the cattle simile marks heedlessness generally without specifying this cognitive mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Cattle-like eating means crude physical indulgence.
changed_reading.after: It also models cognition captured by appetite: what desire decorates is taken in, while the heart becomes unable to reassess the intake.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next detailed comparison places multiple unspoiled rivers on the garden side and administered scalding water that severs intestines on the fire side. The focus's river/eating/fire sequence thus opens into two bodily hydrologies: nourishment sustained from below versus intake weaponized against the organ of digestion.

activation_trace.role: Four watercourses amplify the focus's flowing habitat into diversified, sustained provision.
Caused drinking supplies an opposed delivery channel on the fire side.
Extreme heat transforms water from nourishment into an injuring medium.
Severing supplies the destructive result of that forced intake.
The digestive organ localizes punishment inside the very system foregrounded by the focus's eating.
Repeated eating anchors the context's destructive drinking to the focus's intake motif.
Fire supplies the habitat in which the anti-nourishing liquid operates.

structural_cues: 47:15 resumes the exact garden-river/fire contrast and places liquids on both sides.
The destructive side ends at the digestive anatomy implicated by 47:12's repeated eating.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies parallel liquids, drinking, heat, severance, and intestines; I infer that the sequence deliberately reverses nourishment into anti-nourishment. The alternative is a straightforward catalog of separate rewards and punishments without a shared ingestion mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Rivers decorate paradise, while eating and fire independently characterize the other cohort.
changed_reading.after: The ayah initiates opposed systems of incorporation: sustaining flow becomes drink and fruit, while appetite culminates in a liquid that destroys digestion from within.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus enjoyment root can denote being kept for an extended interval. Later, the decisive hour arrives suddenly, while a deceptive agent decorates retreat and extends its time. Enjoyment therefore reads as reprieve misperceived as permanence, not evidence of a secure destination.

activation_trace.role: Sudden arrival supplies the interruption that exposes enjoyed duration as non-possession.
Deceptive beautification supplies the misreading of temporary extension as favorable security.
One mapped branch supplies temporal prolongation and granted delay.
The alternate mapped root independently preserves duration and length as a live activation.
Being left to benefit for a stretch of time anchors the reprieve reading in the focus verb.
Final residence distinguishes the true endpoint from the preceding extension.

structural_cues: 47:18 juxtaposes waiting with sudden arrival despite signs already having come.
47:25 joins retreat after clarity to beautification and temporal extension.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an enjoyment branch of extended benefit, sudden arrival, deceptive beautification, and prolongation; I infer that delay is mistaken for safety. The alternative is that the focus verb denotes pleasure alone and the later delays are only thematic parallels.

changed_reading.before: The deniers enjoy worldly goods until punishment eventually follows.
changed_reading.after: Their enjoyment is itself the deceptive interval: duration is granted and cosmetically reassuring, but sudden arrival reveals that delay never constituted refuge.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later clause explicitly coordinates one's place of turning or movement with one's lodging. That pair sharpens the focus's otherwise subtle asymmetry between running rivers and fire named as residence: movement and settlement are a deliberate conceptual pair within the packet.

activation_trace.role: Turning and eventual course supply the mobile pole of the explicit pair.
Residence supplies the stationary pole using the same root as the focus's final phrase.
Running water gives the garden half its salient motion.
The repeated residence root marks fire as the salient stationary endpoint.

structural_cues: 47:19 coordinates movement-place and lodging in one balanced clause.
47:12 assigns an explicit lodging only to the fire side while verbal flow characterizes the garden side.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit movement/lodging pair and the focus's run/reside asymmetry; I map the pair back onto the two focus halves. A live alternative is that 47:19 is an inclusive merism about all activity and rest, not a moral contrast between destinations.

changed_reading.before: Running rivers are scenery and fire's lodging is merely a synonym for destination.
changed_reading.after: They are opposing temporal-spatial states: one habitat is marked by continuing life-bearing motion, the other by terminal fixation.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing movement tests disclosed condition, commands believers not to erase their works, and promises that their works will not be deprived. Sound deeds in the focus are therefore not inert merit tokens; they are a trajectory exposed by trial, vulnerable to invalidation, and preserved without loss when maintained.

activation_trace.role: One mapped root supplies testing that makes an inner condition become evident.
The alternate mapped root independently preserves examination as disclosure rather than information gathering.
Active erasure supplies the stated vulnerability of completed works.
Intended acts are explicitly the objects that must not be erased.
Protection from deprivation supplies the counter-operation that preserves rightful work.
The repeated work object ties preservation directly back to the focus qualification.
The focus's deliberate acts are the trajectory later tested, endangered, and preserved.
Soundness names the condition that must survive those operations.

structural_cues: 47:31, 47:33, and 47:35 form a sequence of testing, possible invalidation, and promised non-deprivation.
The repeated second-person possessive on works turns the abstract category into something carried through time.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies trial as disclosure, a prohibition on erasing works, and a promise against their loss; I infer a single preservation trajectory for the focus's sound deeds. The alternative is to read each clause as an independent exhortation or accounting rule.

changed_reading.before: Having once performed righteous deeds is a completed qualification for entry.
changed_reading.after: Sound action is a tested and preservable course: trial reveals it, agents can void it, and divine accompaniment prevents its rightful yield from being taken away.

context_deltas.mechanism: The close links faith to recompense, wealth, spending as outward passage, stinginess, self-harm, divine independence, and human need. Mapped back to the focus, rivers and eating become opposed economies: received provision stays alive by passing through, while appetite and property-consumption retain inward and expose the self's poverty.

activation_trace.role: Recompense for work connects the focus's intentional deeds to a non-consumptive return.
Accumulated property supplies the material whose direction is contested in the closing appeal.
Money leaving in expenditure supplies deliberate outward circulation.
A passage with an outlet gives that circulation a spatial analogue to a running channel.
Repeated withholding supplies the blocked-flow alternative.
The self as the thing itself localizes the cost of blocked circulation in the withholder.
Independence from need rules out divine extraction as the motive for requested spending.
Human need supplies the dependence that intake and hoarding cannot finally cure.
Running provision anchors the productive circulation side in the focus habitat.
The property-consuming branch turns eating into the inward economic operation opposed to expenditure.

structural_cues: 47:36-38 moves from faith and recompense to wealth, requested expenditure, repeated withholding, and self-directed loss.
The focus already juxtaposes continuous flow with repeated intake, providing the material template for that economy.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies water flow, property-consumption, monetary outflow, withholding, self-cost, divine independence, and human need; I supply the hydrological-economic analogy that makes them one mechanism. The alternative is that garden hydrology and spending ethics are adjacent but independent images.

changed_reading.before: Garden rivers are reward scenery, and cattle-like eating is private sensual excess.
changed_reading.after: They also contrast economies of relation: life-giving provision circulates outward, while intake and withholding close around a needy self and become self-impoverishing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the repeated deed-nullification root carries a pastoral branch of abdominal swelling after harmful grazing, not the ordinary abstract gloss expected in these clauses. It remains tightly anchored by the focus's intended deeds, doubled eating, and livestock comparison. Downstream prose should present it as a material lexical resonance that explains the animal image, not claim that every nullification occurrence literally describes livestock pathology.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places sound deeds opposite repeated livestock-like eating; three context clauses repeatedly make the other cohort's deeds come to nothing.

activation_trace.role: Purposeful work supplies what the pastoral process will unexpectedly redescribe.
Repeated feeding anchors the branch's harmful intake mechanism.
Livestock make the grazing pathology materially relevant rather than free association.
The first nullification recurrence activates apparent bodily increase caused by injurious forage.
The second recurrence makes the grazing-to-ruin pattern persistent across the context.
The third recurrence closes the sequence by returning deed-loss to the same harmful-intake image.

changed_reading.before: The cattle simile only says that deniers pursue appetite, while their deeds are separately invalidated.
changed_reading.after: The two claims can form one pastoral mechanism: indiscriminate grazing produces deceptive swelling rather than nourishment, just as their works acquire appearance but collapse in yield.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is form-distant because the focus eating root has a non-dominant mapping to the root of totality, while 47:15 contains that latter root directly. It remains valid as packet-provided split-root material and is anchored by repeated eating followed by the complete fruit provision. Downstream prose must call it a split-mapping echo, not morphology or a replacement gloss for the focus verbs.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus repeats eating, and its packet inventory preserves a second mapped target whose completeness branch appears directly in the next ayah's fruit clause.

activation_trace.role: The non-dominant mapped target contributes encompassing completeness behind the focus's repeated intake.
The context realizes that same mapped branch directly as total inclusion in the garden's provision.
Ripe fruit supplies the concrete provision over which completeness ranges.

changed_reading.before: The contrast is simply animal eating in 47:12 versus a later list of paradise foods.
changed_reading.after: A contained split-root echo opposes repetitive indiscriminate intake to provision characterized by wholeness and complete range.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because non-primary branches of the later words for play and distraction cluster around saliva, animal drool, and tissue at the back of the mouth. The cluster remains anchored in the focus's doubled eating and livestock comparison and changes their sensory field. Downstream prose should render it as an oral-image activation, never as the lexical definition of worldly play or distraction in 47:36.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus makes mouth-directed intake and livestock its dominant image for the second cohort; 47:36 then characterizes proximate life with two roots carrying unusual oral branches.

activation_trace.role: Literal feeding anchors the later oral branch cluster.
Livestock make the animal-mouth branch specifically relevant.
Flow from the mouth gives worldly play an exploratory sensory tie to intake.
The animal-specific oral fluid tightens the tie to the focus comparison.
Tissue bordering the throat extends the cluster from lips and saliva toward ingestion.

changed_reading.before: Worldly play and distraction merely explain why the deniers seek pleasure.
changed_reading.after: At the level of contained branch imagery, worldly absorption becomes mouth-bound and animalized, intensifying the focus's reduction of life to intake.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The focus grammar never says that fire eats the eaters, so that claim would be too strong. Yet the eating inventory itself includes feeding and igniting fire, the fire noun immediately follows the doubled eating image, and 47:15 destroys the digestive tract from within. The reading remains a valid image-level reversal; downstream prose must mark it as activated reciprocity rather than syntactic predication.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Repeated eating is followed by fire as residence, and an eating branch explicitly connects consumption with feeding flame.

activation_trace.role: Feeding flame supplies the reversible edge by which consumers can become fuel.
The burning destination provides the consuming medium adjacent to the eating sequence.
Scalding liquid carries the fire regime into the body.
Severance turns consumption back against the consumer.
The intestines locate the reversal in the organ that should benefit from eating.

changed_reading.before: The deniers eat during life and later inhabit fire.
changed_reading.after: At image level, consumption reverses direction: those defined as eaters enter a fire regime that consumes them and undoes digestion itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-ayah spatial overlay, not an explicit cosmography. It remains anchored because the focus unusually marks life-bearing rivers as below, while 47:35 names the addressed believers as elevated and 47:36 immediately names proximate life with the lower/near root. Downstream prose should preserve the inversion that valuable support lies beneath, while qualifying the upper/lower linkage as a structural resonance.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus specifies water beneath the gardens rather than merely water in them, allowing later elevation and lower-life language to reorganize that locative detail.

activation_trace.role: The lower direction places sustaining flow under the inhabited garden.
Running water makes what lies below an active support rather than a devalued remainder.
Elevation supplies the upper position later assigned to the addressed community.
Honor makes that elevation evaluative as well as spatial.
The lower or nearer life supplies the plane on which temporary enjoyment is confined.

changed_reading.before: The word 'beneath' is a decorative locator in the garden formula.
changed_reading.after: It participates in a layered but non-simple value map: elevated life depends on active provision below, whereas confinement to the lower/near life turns enjoyment into short-range vision.

strongest_changes: The shared covering root no longer supports a simple believer/denier binary: truth can be covered destructively while faults are covered protectively and condition is repaired.
The explicit later pairing of movement and lodging confirms a kinetic contrast already latent between running rivers and fire as fixed residence.
The next ayah converts river, eating, and fire into opposed ingestion systems: sustaining liquids versus scalding intake that destroys intestines.
Righteous deeds become a tested, voidable, yet divinely preservable trajectory rather than completed merit tokens.
The final spending appeal activates the focus hydrology as a social economy of circulation opposed to intake and withholding.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's ordinary reward contrast became materially and relationally dense through exact recurrences: covering reversed polarity, lodging paired with movement, animal eating met a grazing-based nullification branch, and a non-dominant split root linked eating to complete fruit provision. These activations preserve several coexisting readings rather than resolving the ayah to one theme.
remaining_uncertainties: The recognition attached to garden entry may indicate familiarity, assigned location, or simple disclosure; the packet does not force one.
The hydrological-economic circulation model is coherent but its directional link from water flow to spending is reader-supplied.
The harmful-grazing, oral-play, and reversed-eater models are branch-level resonances and should not displace primary syntax.
The total-fruit activation depends on a deliberately preserved but form-distant split mapping and must remain explicitly exploratory.
The movement/lodging pair may be an inclusive statement about all human activity rather than a direct contrast between the two destinations.
